# SAM Fabrication Engineering Work

> Premier architectural metal fabrication, industrial steelwork, custom welding, safety gates, window grills, railings, and sheds across Bangalore, Karnataka, India.

## Business Overview
- Legal / Trade Name: SAM Fabrication Engineering Work (SAM Fabrication)
- Tagline: Stronger Spaces Built with Precision

- Service Coverage: All major residential, commercial, and industrial corridors across Greater Bangalore (Bengaluru)

## Core Fabrication Services & Capabilities

### 1. Entrance Gates & Automation
- Full Service Page: https://samfabrication.in/services/gate-fabrication/
- MS Gates: https://samfabrication.in/services/ms-gates/
- Capabilities: Motorized sliding gates, telescopic sliding gates, bi-folding gates, swing gates, CNC laser-cut sheet metal designer gates with brass and timber accents.
- Materials: Heavy-duty IS 2062 Grade Mild Steel, stainless steel hardware, dual-coat epoxy zinc phosphate anti-rust primer, electrostatic powder coating.

### 2. Window Security Grills
- Full Service Page: https://samfabrication.in/services/window-grills/
- Capabilities: Box pipe safety grills, modern minimalist horizontal grill patterns, CNC laser-cut decorative window panels, balcony safety enclosures.
- Materials: Mild steel square and rectangular hollow sections (RHS/SHS), anti-corrosion primer.

### 3. Railings (Balconies, Staircases & Terraces)
- SS Railings: https://samfabrication.in/services/ss-railings/
- MS Railings: https://samfabrication.in/services/ms-railings/
- Capabilities: AISI 304 Grade stainless steel pipe railings with 12mm toughened glass panels, architectural CNC sheet metal railings, modern mild steel vertical slat balcony railings.

### 4. Custom Metal & Spiral Staircases
- Full Service Page: https://samfabrication.in/services/staircase-fabrication/
- Capabilities: Space-saving spiral staircases, central spine floating staircases, cantilevered stairs, industrial fire escape stairs, external terrace staircases.

### 5. Car Parking Sheds & Tensile Structures
- Full Service Page: https://samfabrication.in/services/car-parking-sheds/
- Capabilities: Cantilever car parking sheds, curved arch roofing, multi-car commercial parking bays.
- Roofing Materials: Multi-wall UV-coated polycarbonate sheets, tensile fabric membranes, pre-coated galvanized iron (GI) profile sheets.

### 6. Industrial Metal Sheds & Structural Steel
- Metal Sheds: https://samfabrication.in/services/metal-sheds/
- Structural Steel: https://samfabrication.in/services/structural-steel-fabrication/
- Capabilities: Heavy industrial I-beam structural fabrication, warehouse PEB frames, mezzanine floors, factory roofing, commercial rooftop canopy extensions.

### 7. Entrance Canopies & Pergolas
- Full Service Page: https://samfabrication.in/services/canopy-fabrication/
- Capabilities: Laminated safety glass entrance canopies, modern MS pergolas with timber-finish metal slats for villa gardens and commercial foyers.

### 8. Custom Welding & On-Site Repair Services
- Full Service Page: https://samfabrication.in/services/custom-welding-fabrication/
- Capabilities: On-site TIG (Tungsten Inert Gas / Argon) welding for stainless steel, MIG (Metal Inert Gas / CO2) welding for structural joints, Shielded Metal Arc Welding (SMAW) for field repairs, gate alignment, hinge replacement, and structural reinforcement.

## Fabrication Rates & Estimations
- Transparent Rate Card: https://samfabrication.in/fabrication-rates-bangalore/
- Estimations: Quotations are provided based on structural drawings, material grades (MS vs SS 304), thickness/gauge specifications, and finishing requirements.
- On-Site Measurements: Consultations and site measurement visits are available across all Bangalore zones. Call or WhatsApp +91 94533 44824.

## Technical Standards & Quality Commitment
- Raw Materials: Certified ISI-marked steel sections from primary Indian manufacturers (Tata Steel, JSW, Jindal, Apollo).
- Welding Workmanship: Argon TIG welding for clean SS joints; multi-pass MIG welding for load-bearing structures.
- Corrosion Protection: Two-coat epoxy zinc chromate primer application before final PU or powder coat finish to withstand Bangalore seasonal rainfall and humidity.
